card.name: Next word in warning and instruction phrases
card.fires_on: Short linking or heading words in label warnings and instructions, such as "or" after "Patients", "to" after "exposes users", "should" after a patient-caregiver subject, and "WARNING" in "SPECIAL WARNING".

modes.label: Boxed warning phrasing
modes.description: The word "to" after "exposes users" at the start of an addiction-risk boxed warning.
modes.example: Hydromorphone hydrochloride extended-release tablets expose users<< to>> risks of addiction, abuse, and misuse

modes.label: Patients or caregivers subject
modes.description: A linking or modal word right after "Patients" or "caregivers" in instructions on who applies or administers the product.
modes.example: Patients (<<or>> caregivers who apply fentanyl transdermal

modes.label: Warning headings
modes.description: The word WARNING in the capitalized heading "SPECIAL WARNING ON INCREASED RISK".
modes.example: SPECIAL<< WARNING>> ON INCREASED RISK OF CARD
